sources.name: NASA POWER Daily (AG)
sources.provider: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project
sources.note: Daily MERRA-2/CERES-derived point values, community AG; fill value -999 converted to null. ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN units verified as MJ/m^2/day from the response header. Elevation from the POWER response (537.67 m).

sources.name: SoilGrids v2.0 (mean, 0-30 cm)
sources.provider: ISRIC - World Soil Information (not a NASA product)
sources.note: Mean of the 0-5, 5-15 and 15-30 cm layers weighted by thickness (5:10:15). d_factor 10 applied (g/kg -> %, dg/kg -> g/kg, pH*10 -> pH).

sources.name: MODIS Terra MOD13Q1 NDVI (16-day, 250 m)
sources.provider: NASA LP DAAC via ORNL DAAC MODIS Web Service
sources.note: MOD13Q1 v061 250m_16_days_NDVI, scale 0.0001, fill -3000 removed; pixel_reliability filter keeps rank 0 (good) and 1 (marginal), drops 2 (snow/ice), 3 (cloudy), -1 (fill). Single 250 m pixel at the point. 272 composites requested from 2015-01-01; 18 dropped by quality filter.

notes: SoilGrids default from the first build was replaced by a retried SoilGrids query.
